annulus.measures_definition: max_component_bbox_iou: largest pairwise IoU of component bounding boxes in normalized layout space; inter_close_fraction: fraction of inter-component node pairs closer than the median intra-component nearest-neighbour distance. Layouts: native kk = nx.kamada_kawai_layout(whole graph) (what km.draw_matplotlib(layout='kk') draws); custom = per-component spring_layout(seed=42) in disjoint bands.
